message.content: This is the final review. All three in-scope claims were rebutted by exhaustive FP16-value sweeps on the actual GPU: intrinsic polynomial error ≤ 4.8e-8, near-boundary kernel output error ≤ 7.5e-8, and large-magnitude outer-branch error ≤ 5.7e-7 with zero elements exceeding 1e-6. The untested mid-range (1.0, 1024) of the outer branch lies between two verified regimes where the output magnitude (and hence absolute error bound) is strictly smaller than at the verified extremes, so no material in-scope problem remains uncovered.
